FISHING LICENCE · TANZANIA

Tanzania fishing licence

Mainland law exempts rod-and-line or handline fishing from a beach without a fishing vessel. This exemption excludes declared trout streams and spawning grounds. Boat trips, conserved areas and Zanzibar need separate checks.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Boat fishing falls outside the beach rod-and-line exemption.
  • Fishing in a conserved area needs a licence or other lawful authority.

Who doesn’t

  • Rod-and-line or handline fishing from a beach without a fishing vessel, except in a declared trout stream or spawning ground.

Extra stamps and permits

  • National park sport-fishing permission and fee
    Where Tanzania National Parks permits sport fishing; each angler pays the applicable fee.

Saltwater

The mainland beach exemption does not extend to a fishing vessel. Check Zanzibar's separate requirements.

Fishing with a guide or charter

A charter does not establish eligibility for the mainland beach exemption. National park sport-fishing rules require a park ranger on board.

Rules visitors should know

  • Do not use the beach exemption in a declared trout stream or spawning ground.
  • Obtain permission before fishing in a conserved area.
  • National park sport fishing is for anglers aged 12 or older.

How to buy

Contact the relevant mainland fisheries office or park office. Ask Zanzibar's fisheries authority about trips in Zanzibar.
